Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

Load data
```{r}
load("../input/Spatial_densities.RData")
traitData = read.csv("../input/raw_files/clinical_data_clean.csv") %>%
  dplyr::filter(AN_clean %in% rownames(data_spatial$Stroma)) #Subset to only patients with clinical data

### Replace '+' with 'plus' to avoid mismatches and change to a numeric matrix
data_spatial <- lapply(data_spatial, function(x) {
  colnames(x) <- gsub("\\+", "_plus", colnames(x))
  x <- as.matrix(x)                     
  storage.mode(x) <- "numeric"       
  return(x)
})
```

Figure 1: CD8 densities across patients

Cells barplots
```{r}
for(tissue in names(data_spatial)){
  data = data_spatial[[tissue]] 
  for(cells in colnames(data)){
    data = data %>%
      data.frame() %>%
      dplyr::mutate(cell_type = data[,cells])
    
    print(ggplot(data, aes(x = rownames(data), y = cell_type)) +
      geom_col(fill = "lightblue", color = "darkblue") +
      labs(title = paste0(cells," density per patient - ", tissue),
           x = "Patient",
           y = paste0(cells, " density")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)))
    
    data$cell_type = NULL 
  }
}
```

Stacked barplot
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# cells colors
my_cols <- c(
  "CD8_plus"           = "red",
  "Tumor_cells_plus"   = "blue",
  "Mature_DC_plus"     = "green3",
  "Pneumocyte_plus"    = "purple",
  "cDC1_plus"          = "orange",
  "pDC_plus"           = "cyan",
  "cDC2_plus"          = "magenta"
)

for (tissue in names(data_spatial)) {
  data <- data_spatial[[tissue]] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Patient")
  
  data_long <- data %>%
    pivot_longer(-Patient, names_to = "Cell_Type", values_to = "Density")
  
  data_long = data_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(Cell_Type != "Pneumocyte_plus")
  
  print(
    ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Patient, y = Density, fill = Cell_Type)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = my_cols) +
      coord_flip() +  # Flip axes to make bars horizontal (vertical layout by patient)
      labs(title = paste0("Stacked cell-type density per patient – ", tissue),
           x = "Patient", y = "Cell-type density") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right"
      )
  )
}
```

Stroma vs Tumor
```{r}
data_spatial$Stroma = data_spatial$Stroma %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Tissue = "Stroma") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ log10(. + 1e-5)))

data_spatial$Tumor = data_spatial$Tumor %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Tissue = "Tumor") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ log10(. + 1e-5)))

combined_df <- bind_rows(data_spatial$Stroma, data_spatial$Tumor)

for (cells in colnames(combined_df)) {
  if(cells == "Tissue") next
  
  combined_df = combined_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cell_type = combined_df[,cells])
  
  # Plot boxplots with p-value annotation
  p <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = Tissue, y = cell_type, fill = Tissue)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, color = "black", size = 1) +
    ggpubr::stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                      comparisons = list(c("Stroma", "Tumor")),
                      label = "p.signif",
                      label.y.npc = "top") +
    labs(title = paste0(cells, " densities in Stroma vs Tumor"),
         x = "Tissue",
         y = "Log10 cell densities") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Stroma" = "darkblue", "Tumor" = "darkturquoise")) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5)
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  combined_df$cell_type <- NULL
}


data_spatial$Stroma$Tissue = NULL
data_spatial$Tumor$Tissue = NULL
```

Prepare df with pvalues from Wilcox tests
```{r}
res = list()
traits = c("all", "mts", "node", "primary")
contador = 1

for (i in traits) {
  # Prepare results dataframe
  results <- data.frame()
  
  for (tissue in setdiff(names(data_spatial), "Total")){
    
    if(i == "all"){
      data_sub = data_spatial[[tissue]] %>%
        data.frame() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Trait = traitData$R.NR)    
    }else if(i == "mts"){
      data_sub = data_spatial[[tissue]] %>%
        data.frame() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Trait = traitData$R.NR,
                      Site = traitData$Site_biopsie) %>%
        dplyr::filter(Site == traits) 
    }else if(i == "node"){
      data_sub = data_spatial[[tissue]] %>%
        data.frame() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Trait = traitData$R.NR,
                      Site = traitData$Site_biopsie) %>%
        dplyr::filter(Site == traits) 
    }else if(i == "primary"){
      data_sub = data_spatial[[tissue]] %>%
        data.frame() %>%
        dplyr::mutate(Trait = traitData$R.NR,
                      Site = traitData$Site_biopsie) %>%
        dplyr::filter(Site == traits) 
    }
  
    for (cells in colnames(data_sub)) {
      if(cells %in% c("Trait","Site", "Tumor_cells_plus")) next
      
      data_sub = data_sub %>%
        dplyr::mutate(cell_type = data_sub[,cells])
        
      # Run Wilcoxon test
      test <- wilcox.test(data_sub[,cells] ~ data_sub$Trait, exact = FALSE)
      
      # Collect results
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        Tissue = tissue,
        Cell_type = cells,
        p_value = test$p.value
      ))
      
      data_sub$cell_type = NULL
    }
  }
  
  # Adjust p-values for multiple testing if needed
  results$p_adj <- p.adjust(results$p_value, method = "BH")
  
  # Create label column for plot
  results$label <- paste0("p = ", signif(results$p_value, 3))
  
  results$feature = paste0(results$Tissue, "_", results$Cell_type)
  
  res[[contador]] = results
  names(res)[contador] = i
  contador = contador + 1
}
```

Lollipop graph
```{r}
for (i in names(res)) {
  data = res[[i]]
  
  data <- data %>%
    arrange(p_adj) %>%
    mutate(feature_label = ifelse(p_adj < 0.05,
                                  paste0("**", as.character(feature), "**"),
                                  as.character(feature)),
           feature_label = factor(feature_label, levels = feature_label))

  
  # Plot
  print(ggplot(data, aes(x = feature_label, y = p_adj)) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = feature_label, xend = feature_label, y = max(p_adj), yend = p_adj),
                 color = "skyblue", size = 1.5) +
    geom_point(color = "darkblue", size = 6) +  # larger dot
    scale_y_reverse() +  # most significant at top
    labs(
      title = paste0("Adjusted p-value lollipop graph for cell densities (R vs NR) - ", i),
      x = "Cell type",
      y = "Adjusted p-value"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 10),  # enable bold via markdown
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
    ) +
    coord_flip())
}
```

Function for survival analysis
```{r}
compute.survival.analysis = function(features, survival.data, time_unit, p.value = 0.05, thres = 0.5, max_factors = Inf) {
  library(survival)
  n_features <- ncol(features)
  significant_combinations <- list() # To store significant feature combinations
  
  # Generate all possible combinations of the features
  contador = 1
  for (n in 1:min(n_features, max_factors)) {
    combinations <- combn(1:n_features, n, simplify = FALSE)
    
    for (comb in combinations) {
      # Create a formula dynamically based on the combination
      formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(time, status) ~", paste(colnames(features)[comb], collapse = " + ")))
      
      # Prepare the data for survival analysis
      data_for_model <- data.frame("time" = survival.data$PFS,
                                   "status" = survival.data$PFS_event) 
      
      data_for_model = cbind(data_for_model, features[,comb, drop=F])
      
      # Fit the Cox PH model with the combination of features (cox PH take into account covariates and measure the impact of each variable in the survival time)
      cox <- rms::cph(formula, data = data_for_model)
      data_for_model$CoxPredictors <- cox$linear.predictors #linear predictors is the risk score for each individual in the dataset
      
      # Check that the model is significant as a predictor (maybe not useful?, it gives the same linear.predictos - to be check)
      cphmodel <- survival::coxph(survival::Surv(time, status) ~ CoxPredictors, data = data_for_model)
      data_for_model$CoxPredictors <- cphmodel$linear.predictors
      
      quantiles <- quantile(data_for_model$CoxPredictors, thres) 
      
      # Binarize the Cox model output to draw two KM lines (linear predictors are used to stratify between high-risk and low-risk groups)
      data_for_model$coxHL <- ifelse(cphmodel$linear.predictors >= quantiles, 'High', "Low") 
      
      # Perform Kaplan-Meier based on coxHL
      km_fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time, status) ~ coxHL, data = data_for_model)
      
      pval <- survminer::surv_pvalue(km_fit, data = data_for_model)$pval #Performs log-rank test to see whether both survival curves are significantly different
      
      if (!is.na(pval) && pval < p.value) {
        significant_combinations[[contador]] <- formula
        names(significant_combinations)[contador] = paste0("Formula_", contador)
        
        pdf(paste0("Results/SurvPlot_", names(significant_combinations)[contador]), width = 10, height = 5, onefile = FALSE)
        print(survminer::ggsurvplot(km_fit,
                         data = data_for_model,
                         size = 1,
                         palette = c("#E7B800", "#2E9FDF"),
                         conf.int.style = "step",
                         pval = TRUE,
                         risk.table = TRUE,
                         risk.table.col = "strata",
                         legend.labs = c("High", "Low"),
                         risk.table.height = 0.3,
                         ggtheme = theme_grey(),
                         title = paste0("Cox PH for ", paste("Surv(time, status) ~", paste(colnames(features)[comb], collapse = " + "))),
                         xlab = paste0("Time to death/recurrence/progression (", time_unit, ")")
        ))
        dev.off()
        contador = contador + 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (length(significant_combinations) == 0) {
    print("No significant combinations found.")
  } else {
    return(significant_combinations)
  }
  
}
```

Compute survival analysis
```{r}
load("../input/Spatial_densities.RData")

### Replace '+' with 'plus' to avoid mismatches and change to a numeric matrix
data_spatial <- lapply(data_spatial, function(x) {
  colnames(x) <- gsub("\\+", "_plus", colnames(x))
  x <- as.matrix(x)                     
  storage.mode(x) <- "numeric"       
  return(x)
})

res_stroma = compute.survival.analysis(data_spatial$Stroma, traitData, "days", p.value = 5, max_factors = 2)
```
